run_make_grpcio_tools: run the script to copy protobuf and protoc plugin sources into the grpcio_tools Python package directory
get_deps_protobuf: get the protobuf C++ and proto file dependencies by running bazel queries and formatting them into a deps file
query_bazel_deps: query bazel for protoc library or well-known protos dependencies using the bazel_deps.sh script
get_protobuf_commit_hash: get the git commit hash of the protobuf submodule HEAD using git rev-parse
convert_to_long_path: convert a file path to Windows long path format with the prefix for paths exceeding 260 characters
